Notes

A single sustained field — no phase changes. The mark field travels left to right along a band that funnels toward a vanishing point on the west wall: large at the outer walls, small and tight through the middle.

Arrows run on their own axis, travelling up and right at 67.93° and leaving through the top of the frame.

Colour is the secondary violet → turquoise pairing: violet enters on the south wall, turquoise on the north, and the two meet across the west wall. The ground is deep violet falling away to almost black at the top of the frame and through the middle of the room. Magenta is not in the room — it is the wayfinding colour.

Nothing rotates: arrows, pixels and pluses are all drawn at their official orientation. The complete plus and pixel cluster patterns drift through the field alongside individual marks.
